description:
Add observed 4xx error responses missing from the Vultr OpenAPI spec for non-database operations. Discovered via live API probing on 2026-05-12 (second pass).

- GET /blocks/{blockId} and GET /blocks/snapshots/{snapshotId}: return 404 (not just 400/403) when the block or snapshot UUID does not exist.
- POST /snapshots: returns 404 when instance_id refers to a non-existent instance (the doc only lists 400).
- POST /object-storage/{objectStorageId}/bucket: returns 404 when the parent Object Storage subscription does not exist; the spec only declares 400/403.

value.description: Not Found (block storage subscription does not exist)
Not Found (block snapshot does not exist)
Not Found (instance_id refers to a non-existent instance)
Not Found (Object Storage subscription does not exist)
